classes.guard: answers only with the path it read; never a decision input

classes.effort_text: medium (high if >3 files or a schema changes)
classes.guard: spec exists; red->green; fresh-context review subagent before merge; 2 failures -> stop and ask

classes.task: Phase from a finished plan, many files

writes the cause with evidence before the fix; one fix per cause (feedback-one-goal-failure-triage)
design doc + test plan before code; 'decide' and 'do' split; design reviewed by a second thread with facts only (OR-24)
classes.how: Opus thread writes, Sonnet thread implements

classes.guard: as designed; focused test; independent PR review; 2 failures -> back to the design thread

classes.task: Critical review of code, plan or PR
classes.effort_text: high (xhigh only for a plan that commits money or is irreversible)

classes.how: Opus thread; Sonnet executes through cloud/runpod.py

every path listed and priced (OR-25); free full analysis before any paid test

classes.how: main agent runs the stage pages
